96909.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit.
  • Desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • [Tech-A]: one eligible technician at this location. A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Switcher" (used by this case only) with two Approved work orders: [WO-1] led by [Tech-A] and [WO-2] with no lead.
  • Work Orders starts in List (the expected results say List is highlighted at the start).
  • Names and numbers are examples; what must hold: there are work orders to show in every display and the page starts in List.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Create everything below in this location.
  3. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] (e.g. Esther Howard).
  4. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Switcher" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  5. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Switcher": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
    • [WO-1] (e.g. S1-702): Lead Technician = [Tech-A].
    • [WO-2] (e.g. S1-352): no lead (Lead Technician left empty).
  6. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > click Search and type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Display Switcher": exactly [WO-1] (lead [Tech-A]) and [WO-2] (no lead) show. If a lead is wrong, fix it on the work order page. Then clear the search; if the page is not in List, click List (tooltip "List") in the display switcher.
96909.custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top navigation.
  2. Click the All tab on the left of the toolbar.
  3. Look at the display switcher at the right of the toolbar and hover each of its buttons.
  4. Write down the label or tooltip of each button and which one is highlighted.
  5. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Tech View (tooltip "Tech View").
  6. Look at which switcher button is highlighted now.
  7. In the display switcher at the right of the toolbar, click Board View (tooltip "Board View").
  8. Look at which switcher button is highlighted now.
  9. In the display switcher, click List (tooltip "List").

154884.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 15 minutes.
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011).
  • [User-A] = you: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch the Admin quick-login user, shown as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit. [User-A] is also a lead technician: active, Time Clock on, this location picked in Location.
  • Desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • [Tech-A]: one other eligible technician at this location. A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Assigned To Me" (used by this case only) with four Approved work orders: [WO-1] and [WO-2] led by you ([User-A]), [WO-3] led by [Tech-A], [WO-4] with no lead.
  • Names and numbers are examples; what must hold: within this customer, exactly two work orders are led by you.

Setup

  1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  2. Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Create everything below in this location.
  3. To make yourself a lead technician: Settings > Staff > your own row's edit icon > Time Clock on, Active, with this location picked in Location > Save.
  4. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: reuse a technician only after checking it is active, has Time Clock on, a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User and this location in Location; otherwise add one: New Staff Member > First Name and Last Name, an Email, Role "Technician", at least one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record them as [Tech-A] (the expected results call it "Ralph Edwards").
  5. Create the customer used only by this case: top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Assigned To Me" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  6. Create these work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Assigned To Me": Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close. Write down the number the build gives the work order (on a QA branch they look like "S10043-17581"). Then pick the lead in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned.
    • [WO-1] (the expected results call it "S1-702"): Lead Technician = [User-A].
    • [WO-2] (the expected results call it "S1-644"): Lead Technician = [User-A].
    • [WO-3] (the expected results call it "S1-691"): Lead Technician = [Tech-A].
    • [WO-4] (the expected results call it "S1-352"): no lead (Lead Technician left empty).
  7. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > Search "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Assigned To Me" shows [WO-1] and [WO-2] (lead: you), [WO-3] (lead [Tech-A]) and [WO-4] (no lead). If your own name is not in the Lead Technician dropdown, redo the "make yourself a lead technician" step; then clear the search.

Preconditions

  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • [User-B] = "Nate Nofinance" (the expected results name him, so keep this name): a second user whose role is a custom role with Work Orders view and, for now, See Financial Data, signed in in a second browser.
  • One technician at this location: [Tech-A] (e.g. "Esther Howard"). A person only counts as a technician here when the staff member is active (not deactivated), Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 No Dollar Amounts" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset, so this case's work orders are kept apart from every other work order at the location.
  • One Approved work order for that customer, [WO-1], led by [Tech-A], with a price.
  • As Nate Nofinance, Total price is on in Tech View's Column Selection menu and in Board View's Fields to display.

Setup

  1. Sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page (you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  2. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member, enter First Name and Last Name (e.g. "Esther Howard") and an email. Pick a Role that is not Office User or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"), pick at least one Department (required), set Location to this location and turn Time Clock on, then click Save & Close. Record as [Tech-A].
  3. Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create Custom Role (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Finance Toggle") > turn on Work Orders view and See Financial Data > Save.
  4. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member for "Nate Nofinance" with an email you can open, Role = the new custom role, at least one Department (required), with this location picked in Location, Time Clock off > Save & Close, then accept the invitation and set a password. Keep him signed in in a second browser.
  5. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name "ZZAUTOTEST F2 No Dollar Amounts" > Save. On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  6. Create the work order: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 No Dollar Amounts" and its Asset > Save, and record its number as [WO-1] (e.g. "S1-702"). The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close.
  7. Set the leads: on an Approved work order pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page; it saves at once. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Leave Lead Technician empty on the ones that should sit in Unassigned. Here: [WO-1] = [Tech-A].
  8. As Nate Nofinance, turn Total price on in Tech View's Column Selection menu and in Board View's Fields to display.
  9. Check the setup worked: as Nate Nofinance, Work Orders > All tab > Search ZZAUTOTEST F2 No Dollar Amounts — Tech View shows a Total price column and the Board View card shows a dollar amount. If not, check his role has See Financial Data on.

A technician is eligible when Time Clock is on, the staff member is active (not deactivated), the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Avatar Group" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset.
  • Work order [WO-1] for this customer: status Approved; Lead Technician Esther Howard; three lines — "Line 1" given to Ralph Edwards, "Line 2" given to Dana Ortiz, "Line 3" with no labor technician; Jenny Wilson holds a Schedule shift on Line 3 (tomorrow 8:00–10:00).
  • What must hold: 4 different people are on [WO-1] (1 lead, 2 line technicians, 1 scheduled technician). The work order number and the line names are examples.

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm each technician below exists and is eligible, or add them with New Staff Member: First Name and Last Name ("Esther Howard", "Ralph Edwards", "Dana Ortiz", "Jenny Wilson") and an email; a Role that is not Office User or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"); at least one Department (required); Location = this location; Time Clock on > Save & Close.
  2. Top menu Customers > New Customer, Name "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Avatar Group" > Save (skip if it already exists). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Record the customer as [Cust-1].
  3. Create a work order with three lines: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in New Work Order pick Customer [Cust-1] and its Asset > Save. The work order opens on its Lines tab with the New Line form open: in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line, turn Line Approved on (this makes the work order Approved) > Save & Add Line for the next line or Save & Close. Record the number shown as [WO-1] (e.g. "S1-644"). Line names in this case (such as "Line 1") are only labels for you: the New Line form's "What Are You Doing?" box only offers ready-made lines (typed text finds no results), so pick any ready-made line for each one (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot") and write down which is which.
  4. On [WO-1] pick Lead Technician "Esther Howard". Lead Technician on the work order page is read-only while the work order is an Estimate; once it is Approved it is a Lead Technician dropdown.
  5. Give "Line 1" to Ralph Edwards and "Line 2" to Dana Ortiz (Edit Line > Technicians). Leave "Line 3" with no labor technician.
  6. On the Schedule, give "Jenny Wilson" a shift on [WO-1] tomorrow 8:00–10:00: Schedule > go to that day > drag the work order from the work order list onto Jenny Wilson's row at the start time > in the picker choose Choose lines and tick Line 3 > set the end time > save.
  7. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Avatar Group" in Search — exactly [WO-1] shows, Approved, Lead Technician Esther Howard; on its Lines tab Line 1 shows Ralph Edwards, Line 2 Dana Ortiz, Line 3 no labor technician; on the Schedule Jenny Wilson's shift on [WO-1] is there tomorrow. Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 organizations · 1 browser · a second location · about 30 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Two organizations on the build under test: A (your usual test organization) and B.
  • In organization B: an eligible technician "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Scope OrgB Tech" and a work order for customer "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Scope OrgB Customer" led by that technician.
  • In organization A: a second location with a work order for customer "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Scope Loc2 Customer" led by a technician enrolled only there.
  • You sign in to organization A as a dispatcher whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > on the Work Orders card, View and Create & Edit are both ticked. The Admin role has both).
  • Window: a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  • Note for the tester: the behind-the-screen scoping and the organization check on a technician sent with a reassignment are developer/automated checks. By hand, confirm only that nothing from organization B, or from the other location, is ever shown or offered.

Setup

  1. If you have no second organization, sign up a new one on the QA build (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Org B").
  2. In organization B: add an eligible technician "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Scope OrgB Tech" (Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: a Role that is not Office User or Time Clock User, at least one Department, Time Clock on > Save & Close) and a work order for customer "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Scope OrgB Customer" (Customers > New Customer, then a contact and an asset as usual) led by that technician.
  3. In organization A: Settings > Locations — use or add a second location; add a technician enrolled only there; Change Location to it (your initials > Change Location) and create a work order for customer "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Scope Loc2 Customer" led by that technician; then Change Location back to your usual location.
  4. Check the setup worked: in organization B, Work Orders > All > search "F3 Scope OrgB" shows the OrgB work order; in organization A at the second location, search "F3 Scope Loc2" shows the Loc2 work order. If either is missing, create it before starting.
154650.custom_steps:
1. In organization A, at your usual location, open Work Orders > All.
  2. Search "F3 Scope OrgB".
  3. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View").
  4. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  5. Search "F3 Scope Loc2" in both views.
  6. Open any card's more-actions > "Reassign lead technician" and search "F3 Scope OrgB Tech", then cancel.

Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · two locations · about 20 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Two locations in your organization (Settings > Locations), e.g. "Heavy Duty" ("Staging Heavy Duty - 9919") and "ZZAUTOTEST Loc2".
  • Three eligible technicians enrolled only at Heavy Duty ("ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie") and three enrolled only at Loc2 ("ZZAUTOTEST Xia X-ray", "ZZAUTOTEST Yan Yankee", "ZZAUTOTEST Zoe Zulu") (Settings > Staff). A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Your pins: nobody is pinned for you at either location (you can pin up to 3 per location).

Setup

  1. Settings > Locations: confirm the second location "ZZAUTOTEST Loc2" exists, or add it.
  2. Settings > Staff: confirm Ana, Ben and Cal have only Heavy Duty picked in Location, and Xia, Yan and Zoe only "ZZAUTOTEST Loc2"; add any that are missing with New Staff Member (at least one Department is required, Time Clock on) > Save & Close.
  3. At each location open Work Orders > Board View and unpin every pinned technician (pin icon in the column header). Write down who was pinned so you can pin them back after the case.
  4. Check the setup worked: at each location Board View shows no pinned columns; Heavy Duty shows Ana, Ben, Cal and Loc2 shows Xia, Yan, Zoe. If a technician shows at the wrong location, fix their Location field.
368156.custom_steps:
1. Click your initials at the top right > Change Location > "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919", open Work Orders > Board View and pin Ana, Ben and Cal (the pin icon in each header).
  2. Try to pin a fourth technician at Heavy Duty and read the message.
  3. Click your initials at the top right > Change Location > "ZZAUTOTEST Loc2" and open Board View.
  4. Pin Xia, Yan and Zoe.
  5. Change Location back to "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" and open Board View.

Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 5 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Technicians (examples, the expected results call them by first name or full name): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie", "ZZAUTOTEST Dan Delta". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • No technician is pinned and your technician order is the starting one: Ana, Ben, Cal, Dan.

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo", "ZZAUTOTEST Cal Charlie", "ZZAUTOTEST Dan Delta" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Work Orders > All > Board View: unpin every pinned technician (pin icon in the column header); write down who was pinned so you can pin them back after the case.
  3. Check the setup worked: Board View shows no pinned column and the four technicians read Ana, Ben, Cal, Dan after Unassigned. If you have reordered them earlier, drag them back into that order first.
368157.custom_steps:

  2. Click Board View in the display switcher (tooltip "Board View").
  3. Pin Cal (the pin icon in his header). Read the column order.
  4. Unpin Cal (the same pin icon). Read the column order.
  5. Click Tech View in the display switcher at the right of the toolbar (tooltip "Tech View").

368159.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 2 browsers · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders). This user is the dispatcher.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • [User-B]: a second browser signed in as another dispatcher at the same location (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Dispatcher Two", a role with Work Orders View and Create & Edit).
  • Technicians (examples, the expected results call them by first name or full name): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customers (used by this case only, each with one contact and one asset): "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Stale On Site Site Co". The steps and expected results call them by the end of the name ("Site Co").
  • Work order Site Co: Approved, lead Ana.

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Dispatcher Two"; skip if one exists) with a role that has Work Orders View and Create & Edit at this location. Record as [User-B] and sign them in in browser 2.
  3. Create this case's customers: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Stale On Site Site Co". For each: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name > Save; on the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact); then the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Create each work order listed in the Preconditions: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate (it opens with the New Line form: pick a ready-made line and Save & Close); for Approved turn on Line Approved on its line; use the status control on the work order page for In Progress, Review (Ready for Review) and Complete; decline the estimate for Declined; Finance tab > Create Invoice for Invoiced; record a payment for the full amount for Paid. Set the lead technician before invoicing. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page (leave it as Unassigned for an unassigned one). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co").
  5. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Stale On Site" in Search — exactly 1 work order shows: Site Co, Approved, lead Ana. [User-B] is signed in in browser 2 at the same location. If anything differs, correct that work order (status or Lead Technician) before starting.
368159.custom_steps:
1. In browser 1, open Work Orders > All, search "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Stale On Site", click List and leave the page open.
  2. In browser 2, open Site Co and change Lead Technician to Ben Bravo on the work order page.
  3. In browser 1, without refreshing, click Site Co's On Site toggle.
  4. In browser 1, refresh and open Site Co. Read Lead Technician.
